Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands over his patient, Jack, who sits on a hospital bed, staring blankly into space 🤯. Dr. Smith holds out a small glass of medication, his voice firm but gentle 💊.

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, it's time for your medication. Please take it, it's for your own good 🤝."

JACK:
"I don't want it. I don't need it. I'm fine 🙅‍♂️."

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, you know the risks. You know what it can do to your mind 🤯. You need to take it, for your own sanity 💀."

JACK:
"I'm not crazy, Doc. I'm just...different 🤪."

DR. SMITH:
"Whatever you say, Jack. But I'm telling you, this medication is the only thing that can keep you stable 📈. Now, please, take it 💉."

Jack refuses, and Dr. Smith is taken aback by his resistance 😮. He tries to reason with him, but Jack remains stubborn 🤬.

DR. SMITH:
"Fine. I'll take it myself, then. I'll show you it's safe 💊."

Dr. Smith picks up the glass and downs the medication in one swift motion 💥. He waits for a moment, expecting nothing to happen 🕰️.

But then, everything changes 🔮.

When Dr. Smith opens his eyes, he finds himself alone in the room 🤔. The hospital bed is empty, and Jack is nowhere to be seen 👻. Confused and disoriented, Dr. Smith looks around, trying to make sense of what's happening 🤯.

As he stumbles out of the room, he catches a glimpse of himself in a mirror 📸. And that's when it hits him - he's the one who's been imagining the whole thing 🤯. He's the one who's been pretending to be sane 🤪.

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in horror as he realizes the truth 🤯. He's been living in a world of his own making, creating a reality that's not real 🌐.

The camera zooms out, and we see the hospital room, empty and still 🏥. But on the wall, a message is scrawled in red ink: "I'm not crazy, Doc. I'm just...different" 🤪.

FADE TO BLACK 🎥
